positions.name: MeridianDeployGate
positions.frame: what gate must Meridian deployments pass before shipping?
positions.why: Both expressions declare the same requirement — a signed release manifest must precede any Meridian deployment — one as prose, one as a structured gate specification. The frame reads both as answering what the gate is.

positions.name: MeridianGateRationaleAndScope
positions.frame: what incident and which environments define the Meridian deployment gate's reach?
positions.why: src-2 names the triggering incident — two unsigned artifacts reached staging last quarter — that motivated the gate, while src-4 specifies the environments — staging and production — the gate covers. Together they define why the gate exists and where it applies.
